office_does: Grant PUD's five elected commissioners set policy, review operations and approve the budget for the county's public electric and fiber-broadband utility, which owns the Priest Rapids and Wanapum dams.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Nelson Cox, board secretary and a Warden farmer, is the only candidate for the four-year at-large term; the whole county votes.

candidates.summary: Grant PUD at-large commissioner since 2018 and current board secretary; has farmed his family's land near Warden for more than 45 years. The only candidate on the ballot; no voters'-guide statement.
highlights: First elected in 2018; re-elected unopposed in 2022 [S2][S4]
Board secretary; Warden farmer active in agricultural organizations [S2]
